frontier.hypothesis: The pure-C axis is closed and what remains is a DISPOSITION question, not a grinding question. Five modalities (structural, permuter x4, synthesis, forensics x2, rederive x2) have now measured the same ceiling from the source side, the RTL side, the compiler-source side and, this session, the arithmetic side.
frontier.mechanism: Reaching 0 requires block 1 to hold &D_80106A73 in an address pseudo DISTINCT from the one blocks 2 and 4 use - distinct so it can take a different hard register, and distinct so its MEM misses the cse hash entry its own store left. One C object is one DECL_RTL is one pseudo (global.c:426 gives one allocno per pseudo and GCC 2.7.2 has no live-range splitting), so one C object can supply neither. s17 adds the exact-cost statement: the only single-object way to recover the reload costs precisely the one point it recovers.

Gate 1 is already evaluated and FAILS (scan_hand_coded tier=LOW, 0/8). The BB2-internal precedents (func_80037F40 at src/code6cac_c_mid.c:196+211; func_8003504C at src/code6cac_b.c:3941-3942) are NOT substitutes - neither is a matched function and the standing 2026-07-27 ruling requires a SOTN-master citation for a coercion/spelling family. frontier.hypothesis: e1 (score 11, 50 insns, target's exact lbu 176 / sb 164 census) is a better base than the score-10 form for any FUTURE lever that can remove one lui, because its only structural defect is that one instruction plus register naming, whereas the score-10 form is missing a whole memory access.
frontier.mechanism: Distance-10 and distance-11 are nearly equal, but they are not equally close in shape: the score-10 form differs from target in the ACCESS PATTERN (175 lbu vs 176), which no register-level lever can fix, while e1 differs only by one address materialisation. A hypothetical lever that shares the symbol read's 'lui $at' with an existing base materialisation would land e1 at or near 0.
frontier.next_probe: Only worth one turn, and only if a future session finds a sanctioned construct that changes address materialisation sharing (nothing known does). Concretely: is there any C shape in which GCC reuses one 'lui %hi(D_80106A73)' for BOTH a symbol-addressed access and a pointer materialisation? Read tools/gcc-2.7.2/config/mips/mips.c's %lo folding in combine to answer it from source before spending measurements; expect the answer to be no, since the pointer form needs the addiu and the MEM form does not.

frontier.next_probe: No probe needed - this is a standing caveat for reading s17's and any future session's numbers. It does NOT affect the 10-point residual itself, which s16 localised to register naming and one missing memory access, neither of which is a relocation artefact.
